comment: Lets a vanilla stone pile migrate itself into a rock pile as its chunk loads — but only when convertVanillaPilesOnLoad is set in ModConfig/acervuslapidum.json. It is off by default: vanilla piles work perfectly well beside ours, and rewriting a world on install is not this mod's to do. /rockpile convert and /rockpile revert are the deliberate way in and out.
